native_ecl_write_semantics.opcode_0x83: arg0 writes max HP +0x2e00, current HP +0x2dfc, and phase-start HP +0x2e04; other conditional side effects are outside this atlas
native_ecl_write_semantics.opcode_0x84: arg0 calls timer_set_elapsed on phase timer +0x2e14
native_ecl_write_semantics.opcode_0x85: arg0 selects slot; arg1 always writes threshold +0x3358[slot]; arg2 writes successor +0x3368[slot] only on the full-configuration engine-mode branch
native_ecl_write_semantics.opcode_0x86: arg0 always writes timeout +0x3378 and resets phase timer +0x2e14; arg1 writes successor +0x337c only on the full-configuration engine-mode branch

native_transition_order.health_priority: health transitions scan slots 0..3 and win over timeout; multiple crossed slots may be consumed in one update
native_transition_order.manager_order: strict current_hp < threshold and integer timeout checks run before later same-update player-shot HP subtraction
native_transition_order.pending_overshoot: post-damage HP may sit below a retained threshold until the next eligible manager update
native_transition_order.timeout_restore: timeout restores the greatest positive retained health threshold before starting its configured successor

next_gate.join_key: content digest + stage + gameplay epoch + Boss pointer + main VM instruction pointer + threshold/timeout registry
required_measurements: pre/post HP registry and integer timer
survival-equivalent damage action and exposure delta

static_limit.control_flow: reachable sites and literal transition edges are a route/difficulty, full-configuration-mode CFG overapproximation; branch alternatives are not simultaneous runtime writes
static_limit.engine_mode: when the successor-write gate is false, opcodes 0x85 and 0x86 retain the previous successor register; ECL content alone cannot identify that runtime successor
static_limit.local_vm_time: instruction-local time is not an absolute manager-frame phase deadline
static_limit.successor_effect: literal successor identity is exact content, but actual execution and resulting ECL state require an immutable runtime root
